title: Sequence
info: Sequence means order. First, next, and last keep a story straight.
Clue words include first, then, next, after, and finally.
If the order changes, the story can stop making sense.

questions.q: Which word is a sequence clue?
In a recipe, order matters because
options: Some steps must happen before others
Flour can be added after eating

questions.q: First you plant a seed. Next you water it. Last it may
options: Become the first step again with no water

questions.q: Type the sequence word that often starts a list of steps.
